description: Create a campaign as a DRAFT for the user to review and send from the dashboard. This tool never sends — there is deliberately no send tool, because a mistaken broadcast reaches the entire audience. Audience: 'all' contacts, a 'segment' (segmentId), or an ad-hoc 'filter' condition tree. Optional A/B subject test via abSubjectB + abSamplePct.

abSamplePct.description: Percent of the audience in the A/B sample (5–50).

abSubjectB.description: Variant-B subject line for an A/B test.

audience.description: Who receives it. `all` = every subscribed contact. `segment` = an existing segment, and requires `segmentId`. `filter` = an inline condition tree, and requires `filter` — use it for a one-off audience you do not want to keep. Unsubscribed contacts are excluded from all three, since campaigns are marketing mail.

filter.description: Required when audience = 'filter'. Same condition DSL as segments.

field.description: See field namespaces in the parent description.

operator.description: See valid operators in the parent description.

value.description: Comparison value (string, number, or boolean). Omit for exists/notExists/triggered.

fromEmail.description: Sender address. Its domain must be verified for this project or the send is refused — check volanea_get_project_status for which domains are verified before choosing one.

fromName.description: Display name shown beside the from address, e.g. "Volanea Team".

name.description: Internal name for the campaign list — never shown to recipients. The subject is what they see.

previewText.description: The preview snippet most clients show beside the subject. Omit it and they fall back to the first words of the HTML, which is usually a logo alt-text or an unsubscribe line.

replyTo.description: Where replies go, if not the from address. Its domain does NOT need verifying. Point it at a real inbox — or at an inbound address, whose local part keeps its case so a ticket token survives the round trip.

subject.description: Subject line recipients see. Supports {{variable}} placeholders, including the {{name | "default"}} fallback form.

name: volanea_create_campaign_draft

code.description: Machine-readable failure code to branch on. Present only when success is false.

status.description: Always draft — this server has no tool that sends a campaign; a human does that.

error.description: Human-readable failure reason. Present only when success is false.

success.description: False when the call failed; read `error` and `code` in that case.
